description.value: Seaview Suites is a family-owned premium suite property on Cordova Bay Road offering fully furnished one-bedroom suites with ocean views overlooking Haro Strait and towards Mount Douglas Park. Each suite comes with a full kitchen, ensuite washer/dryer, and complimentary Wi-Fi, making the property well-suited for self-catering stays of a week or longer. Located near the Cordova Bay area and a straightforward 20-30 minute ride from BC Ferries' Swartz Bay terminal, it sits at a natural entry point for cyclists arriving on Vancouver Island.
